headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and card titles. Do NOT use Inter.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and standard UI text.

mono.usage: Use for IDs, numbers, currency (₹), data tables, and verification codes.

primary.description: Enterprise Green for primary actions, active states, and success metrics.

background.description: Pure white for main background to ensure max readability.

surface.description: Black surfaces as requested. Use for Sidebar, specific high-impact KPI cards, and Tooltips.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High density for data, generous padding for containers. 'Swiss Brutalist' precision.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed width 260px, black background (#09090B), white text, green active states. Sticky left.
spacing_and_layout.header: Height 64px, white background, bottom border (border-zinc-200). Sticky top, z-50. NO transparent backgrounds.
spacing_and_layout.content_area: Padding p-6 or p-8. Max-width constraints on forms, full-width for tables.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Sharp or max 6px radius. 1px border. Solid backgrounds. No soft blurry shadows.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style for dashboards. KPI cards: col-span-1. Charts: col-span-2 or 3. Data Tables: col-span-full.

buttons.primary: bg-[#059669] hover:bg-[#047857] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#09090B] hover:bg-[#27272A] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-zinc-200 hover:border-[#09090B] text-zinc-900 bg-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors

tables.header: bg-zinc-50 border-b border-zinc-200 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4
tables.pagination: flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-white border-t border-zinc-200

cards.kpi: bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-6 rounded-md flex flex-col gap-2 hover:border-[#059669]/50 transition-colors
cards.kpi_dark: bg-[#09090B] text-white p-6 rounded-md flex flex-col gap-2 border border-[#27272A]

forms.input: border border-zinc-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#059669]/20 focus:border-[#059669] transition-all bg-white
forms.label: block text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 mb-1.5

badges.active: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium
badges.pending: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium
badges.inactive: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium

login.layout: Centered card on a subtle dotted/grid background. Split layout (Left: branding/green, Right: form).
login.features: Mobile Number + Password. Brand logo, Tagline prominently displayed.

dashboard.kpis: Total Orders, Revenue, Active Riders, Products, Sellers, Customers.
dashboard.live_map: Embedded Google Maps placeholder with Rider pins.

user_management.layout: List view with advanced filtering (Role: Customer, Seller, Rider, Staff, Admin). Search bar. Action column.

product_management.layout: Table with image thumbnail, title, category, price, stock status toggle.

order_management.layout: Dense table. Lifecycle stages as badges. Clickable row to Order Detail.

business_rules.layout: Settings-style forms. Configurable sliders or inputs for commission %, radius km, thresholds.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 2px. Clean and professional.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 everywhere to separate sections. Grid-like technical layout.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use pure Inter for headings. Use Manrope or Cabinet Grotesk.
Maintain strict High-Contrast: White backgrounds, Black sidebar/surfaces, Enterprise Green (#059669) highlights.
Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns. Always use solid white or black.
Use data-testid on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs).
Forms should use Shadcn standard inputs, customized to match the strict borders.
For KPI cards, use an 'Optical Clarity' approach. Crisp 1px borders, bold monospace numbers.
Never center-align paragraphs or tables. Always left-align for data readability.
Implement hovering micro-interactions (e.g. slight border color change to green, text color shift).
Use JetBrains Mono or similar monospace for all financial figures (₹) and data IDs.
instructions_to_main_agent: Start by setting up the basic layout: a fixed Black sidebar and a fixed White header.
Implement the Dashboard route first to establish the visual language (KPIs, Chart placeholders).
Create reusable table component for User, Product, and Order management.
Use proper Shadcn components for Dropdowns, Dialogs, Tabs, customized via standard Tailwind utility classes.
Do not build HTML date pickers or selects. Use Shadcn.
Ensure all monetary values use the ₹ symbol and monospace font.
Create a realistic map placeholder using a gray background with some marker icons for 'Live Rider Monitoring'.
Make sure the sidebar clearly indicates the active route with a Green highlight or text.
